correctness.rationale: Definitions quantify over every coalition, joint action and opponent profile. The two-agent 2x2 matrix classification checks all seven action-flip classes and distinguishes them via exact singleton-coalition outcome ranges. A direct two-table witness is verified for each of eight coalitions and is inequivalent by the 3-versus-2 number of ones, even with agent/outcome relabelings. The standalone checker exhausts all 4+16+256 Boolean tables, constructs signatures directly from coordinate fibers, groups by independent action flips, and obtains exact 3,7,41 signatures and 3,7,46 orbits, with three nontrivial fibers 2/2/4 orbits on 12/12/32 tables. Burnside independently proves 3/7/46. No infinite extrapolation or partial scan is involved.

The earlier 2-agent basic-power representation does not imply the exact three-agent census. Full Wang preprint could change this conclusion.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: An equivalent formulation would classify Boolean cubes by the unordered sets of colors occurring on EVERY coordinate subcube, modulo independent coordinate bit flips. Prior statements about only upward-closed coalition power do not control inclusion of non-minimal exact outcome ranges, so they cannot automatically imply the 41/46 figure. Conversely, the present theorem implies noninjectivity of such coarser powers but only for this fixed binary domain.

originality.rationale: The fully read 2026 motivating paper proves representability of individual-agent actual effectivity, not injectivity of the tuple of exact ranges of EVERY coalition. Earlier state/path coalition effectivity theory focuses on upward-closed powers; general nonuniqueness of abstractions is explicitly prior knowledge and NOT the novelty claim. An exact finite 3-agent, 2-action, 2-outcome threshold and its 41/46/2-2-4 census were not found in the scoped published comparisons. The nearby Wang preprint presents coalition value-range hypergraphs, but its full text was unavailable: possible equivalent coverage is an identified risk, not a claimed exclusion.
residual_risks: Full text of the Wang 2026 value-range-hypergraph paper was inaccessible; the exact finite comparison remains unresolved and could be relevant.

Publication searches and finite source inspections cannot certify global mathematical novelty.

value.rationale: Whether an abstract exact-coalitional effectivity description retains the concrete action structure is directly relevant to invertibility of action semantics; retaining every coalition and every non-monotone achievable range is stronger than familiar monotone coalition power. The minimal binary domain isolates the first essential overlap of three agents and supplies a complete orbit/signature classification, with a concrete nonreconstructibility certificate. The numerical finite invariant is natural because two actions and outcomes are minimal nontrivial and k=3 is the first nonfaithful case; it is not a gratuitous parameter slice.
